##### Project general facts

Lexington is a contemporary residential development in Town Square Dubai, offering a refined collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, including spacious three-bedroom duplexes. Designed to balance modern elegance with everyday comfort, the project features sleek architecture, expansive glazing, and thoughtfully planned interiors that create bright, welcoming living spaces. With clean lines, contemporary styling, and a strong emphasis on functionality, Lexington presents an ideal home for those seeking a well-connected urban lifestyle within a vibrant community setting.

The development is designed to support an active and balanced lifestyle, surrounded by landscaped trails and open green spaces ideal for jogging, walking, and outdoor relaxation. Residents also benefit from a curated range of wellness and leisure amenities that enhance everyday comfort while fostering a sense of community in one of Dubai’s most family-friendly neighborhoods.

Each residence is finished with high-quality modern materials and carefully designed to maximize comfort and practicality. Interiors feature elegant porcelain flooring, built-in wardrobes, and fully equipped kitchens fitted with German-made appliances, creating stylish and functional homes tailored to contemporary living.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a dynamic and family-friendly community that blends modern urban living with a vibrant lifestyle. Located along Al Qudra Road, it offers excellent connectivity to key areas of Dubai, including Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai. Designed with sustainability and convenience in mind, the district features a range of residential options, from stylish apartments to spacious townhouses, catering to families, professionals, and individuals seeking a balanced lifestyle in a serene environment.

The heart of Town Square is its vibrant central park, which spans over 50,000 square meters, providing a lush green space for recreation and relaxation. The community is equipped with a host of amenities, including jogging and cycling tracks, skate parks, children’s play areas, and outdoor gyms, making it an ideal place for active lifestyles. In addition, the Town Square boulevard is lined with shops, cafes, and restaurants, offering residents a lively social hub with everything they need close at hand.

With its focus on family-oriented living, Town Square also boasts top-tier educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and a variety of leisure options, including cinemas and splash parks. The community’s well-planned layout ensures a harmonious blend of urban convenience and natural beauty, making it a sought-after destination for those looking for a modern yet tranquil place to call home in Dubai.
